entries.en: Olmxio bears most ominous tidings: the diabolical Diluxio and his lackeys have begun the rite of birthing, and stand poised to claim the immeasurable powers of the Chosen One for their own. Speak with Elder Frixio and form a plan to halt the ritual and bring the yet-sealed podling back to Little Solace.
entries.fr: Diluxio aurait déjà commencé le rituel de naissance de l'Inspiré. Il n'y a plus de temps à perdre, il va falloir trouver un plan, et vite. Allez chercher conseil auprès de Frixio.
entries.ja:
前回までの冒険録：
冒険者の活躍により、無事に「シルフの仮宿」に保護された「伝説の御子」のゆりかご。しかし、ヘッポコ学者の「ヴォイス」の失態による冒険者の不在に乗じ、「悪い子シルフ」の「ディルシオ」は、伝説の御子のゆりかごを再び「シルフ領」に奪い去ってしまう。伝説の御子の羽化まで、もう時間がない……！緊急事態に際し、シルフの仮宿の長「フリクシオ」は、冒険者に対し最後のお願いを依頼する……。
　　　　　　　　　　　　*　*　*
悪い子シルフのディルシオが、ついに伝説の御子の誕生の儀式を始めたようだ。儀式を阻止するため、シルフの仮宿の「フリクシオ」と相談しよう。

entries.en: The overstrung scholar Voyce has finally snapped completely, believing himself to be a heroic chocobo and insisting to accompany you on your quest to rescue the Chosen One from Diluxio's clutches. Rendezvous with the self-styled “Voco” by the entrance to the Sylphlands.
entries.fr: Le seul plan que les Sylphes du Refuge ont trouvé est de vous envoyer reprendre la cosse dans les Terres sylphes. Comme si le danger n'était pas suffisant, Voyce a décidé de vous accompagner pour vous <italic(1)>aider<italic(0)>. Parlez-lui pour entreprendre ensemble une énième mission de sauvetage qui ne sera pro<->ba<->ble<->ment pas de tout repos.

entries.en: As expected, Voco will require your protection while offering little in return. Keep the crazed bird-man out of harm's way and make for the Seedbed. Should Voco wander away, return to the starting point and try anew.

entries.en: You have successfully navigated your way through the Sylphlands, and the Seedbed stands before you. Speak with Voco in hopes that he will manage not to sabotage the rescue effort with his typical bumblings.
entries.fr: Vous êtes enfin au Berceau. Entretenez-vous avec Voyce pour décider de la marche à suivre.
entries.ja: 伝説の御子のいる場所にたどりついた。ゆりかごの大樹の「チョコヴォイス」と話そう。

entries.en: By some miracle, the scholar Voyce maintained a shred of sanity, managing to snatch up the podling while Diluxio was otherwise distracted. Fend off Diluxio's underlings and meet up with the unlikely hero east of the Seedbed.
entries.fr: À votre plus grande surprise et celle de Diluxio, Voyce a réussi à reprendre la cosse. Il semble peu probable cependant qu'il parviendra à la porter sans aide jusqu'au Refuge. Retrouvez-le dans les Terres sylphes pour l'aider avant qu'il ne lui arrive malheur.
entries.ja: ヴォイスの活躍によって、伝説の御子を奪い返すことに成功した。ゆりかごの大樹の東方面に逃げていった「ヴォイス」を探し、追手のディルシオ一味を倒してヴォイスを救助しよう。

entries.en: Voyce gave all that he had, but his legs will carry him no further. To see that the ill-fated scholar's sacrifice will not be in vain, take the sylph podling into hand.

entries.en: The Chosen One has emerged from her podling to recognize Elder Frixio as her nurturing one. Raised in the peaceful surroundings of Little Solace with those who will teach her love and kindness, the Chosen One will surely lead her people into an era of peace and prosperity. In other news, it turns out that the bungling scholar Voyce still lives, much to the chagrin of all who find themselves in his company. Leave him to his bumblings and report back to Commander Heuloix in Gridania on the success of the sylphic campaign.
entries.fr: Vous êtes arrivé<if(gnum4,e,)> à temps au Refuge. L'Inspiré est né et il est cer<->tai<->ne<->ment entre de bonnes mains. Il est temps de faire votre rapport au colonel Heuloix.

entries.en: You report to Commander Heuloix, only to learn that the insufferable Voyce has already submitted a report and taken credit for the lion's share of your deeds.
